cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I Changed the Odds
cards.instruction: Hide how your own choice tilted the contest, bargain, or consequence while continuing to judge the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First prize to my cake, then. We can stop rearranging the table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You copied me moving my cake away from the window. Mine was melting; yours ended up alone under the judging lamp.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, temperature control. They still chose it for the flavor.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They never tasted mine. They couldn't see its entry number behind yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then record yours as unjudged, not beaten. There's no reason to change the cake they did choose.
